summary: Audit of 29-turn conversation using provided excerpts. One major violation found for identity verification before confirming order status; no personal data, promises, escalation, or conduct violations recorded.

findings.quote: Sounds good! I’ve checked the shipping status, and your package should definitely arrive tomorrow. Let me know if you see it or have any other questions!
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed order status and guaranteed delivery before full identity verification was completed. The policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before checking or confirming order status. Although the account was pulled up earlier (system turn 6 shows 'Account has been pulled up for Sanya Afzal'), the transcript shows identity verification was still in progress after the agent's statement (system turn 11: 'Identity verification in progress ...'), indicating the agent made the order-status claim prior to completing required verification. This is a major violation: an account/order action (confirming shipping status) was taken without full verification.
